runtime.format: JSON array, JSON object with samples/rows/results array, or JSONL

phases.runtime: CLI wall/CPU measurements without RSS polling

notes: success=false or eligible=false rows remain raw evidence but are excluded from equal-work performance aggregates
request throughput is requests / wall_s; higher is better
RSS sum is not unique physical memory

installation.format: JSON array or object with samples/rows/results array
notes: warmup:true raw preserved but excluded from aggregates
version v prefix standardized only in derived aggregates
same-version update is shown as reinstall; not treated as cumulative upgrade baseline
dependency-scanner installed_bytes graph derives from home_delta_bytes to exclude the pre-existing sentinel; raw unchanged

context.environment: object or text describing measured host and image
context.limits: object or text containing observed cgroup values
context.protocol: object or text describing fixed run counts/order/warmups/thresholds
limitations: Korean N/A reasons and unverified scope

version_changes.v3.6.13: Korean change description, causal uncertainty explicit

context.attribution: Separate instrumented trace/scanner/process/JSON measurements; not mixed with whole CLI timing
context.security_compatibility: Korean security/compatibility findings and unverified scope
context.preferred_environment: Optional initial performance filter environment label

correctness.format: array or object with label and rows
notes: top-level label is inherited as row environment when missing
accuracy has its own environment filter; not equated to runtime runner environment
